# Web Vitals 6.2.3

Unmodified standard build from the official npm package `web-vitals@6.2.3`, downloaded from https://registry.npmjs.org/web-vitals/-/web-vitals-6.2.3.tgz and verified against its published SHA-512 integrity. Source: https://github.com/GoogleChrome/web-vitals. Apache-2.0 license included. The source map is included for local debugging.

This library calculates browser metrics locally. Our adapter transmits only fixed metric names and rating buckets; it never transmits the library's metric IDs, navigation URLs, entries, DOM references, raw timings, or attribution. No CDN or third-party analytics requests are used.
